definitions: A woman of breeding or higher class, a woman of authority.
The color of the setting sun, blood, and strawberries; the color which is evoked by the longest visible wavelengths (between about 625–740 nm), and a primary additive color.
A revolutionary socialist or (most commonly) a Communist;  a Bolshevik, a supporter of the Bolsheviks in the Russian Civil War.
Having an orange-brown or orange-blond colour; ginger.

entries.title: The Lady in Red (Chris de Burgh song)

blocks.text: "The Lady in Red" is a song by Irish singer-songwriter Chris de Burgh. It was released on 20 June 1986, by A&M Records, as the second single from his eighth album, Into the Light (1986). Charting at number one in several countries and reaching the top three in the United States, the song was responsible for introducing de Burgh's music to a mainstream audience worldwide. However, this song was his only major international hit.

entries.title: The Lady in Red (Allie Wrubel song)

blocks.text: "The Lady in Red" is a 1935 song with lyrics by Mort Dixon and music by Allie Wrubel. Its title may have been inspired by Ana Cumpănaș, referred to in newspapers at the time as the "lady in red." She was in the company of John Dillinger just before he was shot by the FBI in July 1934, and was said to have betrayed him to the law. The song makes no mention of such subject matter, and it is written in a quasi-Latin rhumba style.

A Lady in Red or Red Lady is a type of female ghost, similar to the White Lady, but according to legend is more specifically attributed to a jilted lover, killed in a fit of passion, or a woman of vanity. In all cases, the Lady in Red is wearing a scarlet or blood red dress. She is said to typically be friendly in disposition, with a story attached to historic hotels, theatres or other public places, with a higher frequency of reports.

Lady in Red is a half-length portrait painting done in 1928 by Sri Lankan artist Mudaliyar A. C. G. S. Amarasekara, that was accidentally discovered in the National Art Gallery in Cinnamon Gardens, Colombo, Sri Lanka.
